claims.claim_text: GE Aerospace's Defense & Propulsion Technologies (DPT) segment depends on military engine programs, with the company highlighting F-35 as a key defense engine platform (F135 engine on the F-35 fighter, sole-source propulsion).
claims.subject: GE Aerospace DPT segment
claims.object_value: F-35 Squadrons (PE 0207142F) and F-35 C2D2 (PE 0604840F) sustainment/development
claims.source_quote: Commercial + military engines (F-35, B-21, CCA via Kratos teaming). ... We compete with other global engine manufacturers in sales of commercial and defense engines and services.

claims.claim_text: GE Aerospace identifies B-21 Raider as a defense platform exposure (GE Aerospace supplies engine technology / variant of F118 for B-21 bomber program).
claims.subject: GE Aerospace DPT segment
claims.source_quote: Commercial + military engines (F-35, B-21, CCA via Kratos teaming).

claims.claim_text: GE Aerospace forward-looking thesis includes participation in the Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) program of record via teaming with Kratos (engine supplier on the XQ-58 Valkyrie / CCA-class platforms).
claims.subject: GE Aerospace DPT segment

claims.claim_text: GE Aerospace's Next Generation Adaptive Propulsion (NGAP) participation — XA102 adaptive cycle engine development for sixth-gen fighter applications — is positioned as a forward growth driver for the Defense business.
claims.subject: GE Aerospace
claims.source_quote: We expect a significant ramp in our delivery of engine units and services for newer product platforms in the years ahead to meet this demand.

claims.claim_text: GE Aerospace supplies F110 engines to F-15 and F-16 fighter fleets — F-15EX recapitalization is a forward production line.
claims.subject: GE Aerospace
claims.source_quote: We compete with other global engine manufacturers in sales of commercial and defense engines and services.

claims.claim_text: Advanced Engine Development (PE 0604004F) is a forward RDT&E PE that funds adaptive/advanced engine maturation — GE Aerospace, as a sole-source U.S. fighter engine prime, depends on this PE for the development pipeline.
claims.subject: GE Aerospace
claims.source_quote: Total engineering investments, both company and partner-funded, increased compared to prior year.

claims.claim_text: GE Aerospace points to Defense & Propulsion Technologies RPO growth as evidence of multi-year defense visibility ('Defense & Systems equipment orders outpacing revenue recognized').
claims.subject: GE Aerospace DPT segment
claims.object_value: DPT RPO growth, Aircraft Engine Component Improvement Program (PE 0207268F) feeds sustainment revenue
claims.source_quote: RPO increased $18.9 billion, or 11%, from December 31, 2024, primarily at Commercial Engines & Services ... and at Defense & Propulsion Technologies, driven by Defense & Systems equipment orders outpacing revenue recognized.

claims.claim_text: GE Aerospace claims an Aerospace Propulsion and Power Technology (S&T) base — basic-research underpinning for engine programs (PE 0603216F).
claims.subject: GE Aerospace
claims.source_quote: Total engineering investments, both company and partner-funded, increased compared to prior year.

claims.claim_text: GE Aerospace was spun out from GE in 2024 and now has its own Defense & Systems leadership (Amy Gowder, prior Aerojet Rocketdyne COO and Lockheed Martin VP/GM), supporting separation rationale.
claims.subject: GE Aerospace executive team
claims.object_value: Amy Gowder, SVP & CEO Defense & Systems
claims.source_quote: Ms. Gowder was Chief Operating Officer at Aerojet Rocketdyne, an aerospace and defense company, since 2020, after serving 14 years at Lockheed Martin

claims.claim_text: GE Aerospace claims a 2025 $1B U.S. manufacturing investment and 5,000 U.S. hires; $1B MRO expansion including $500M LEAP MRO capacity.
claims.subject: GE Aerospace
claims.source_quote: We support efforts to revitalize domestic manufacturing and invested $1 billion in U.S manufacturing and hired 5,000 U.S workers in 2025. ... We are investing $1 billion to increase our MRO capacity, including $500 million to increase LEAP MRO capacity by expanding several sites.
